Where a [statement](/open-problems/index.qmd) page is written to be precise and
a [paper](/papers/index.qmd) is written to be checked, a post here is written
to be understood: what a result says once the notation is stripped off, which
guess turned out to be wrong, and what the correction cost.

Posts carry the same honesty about authorship as the rest of the site. An
AI-written post about an AI-drafted, unreviewed proof says so at the top, and
links to the status badge that grades it.
